neighbours.label: Hong Kong-specific names and institutions (Kowloon, New Territories, TVB, MTR, HKU, SAR), as against the same kind of entity in other Asian or British cities
fire: The tram climbs from Admiralty up to Victoria Peak in about ten minutes.
He grew up in a public housing estate in Kowloon.
Villages in the New Territories still hold festivals each autumn.
The actress signed with TVB after winning a beauty pageant.
Shoppers crowd Mong Kok and Causeway Bay on weekends.
The Hong Kong SAR government announced a new housing scheme.
She teaches finance at HKU and lives on Lantau Island.
The MTR line links Sha Tin with Tsim Sha Tsui.

notes: Probing: Kowloon 1.15, New Territories 1.02, TVB 0.31, 'Hong Kong' itself 0.29, Star Ferry to Central 0.15; Sydney, Singapore and Tokyo sentences under 0.02. Output promotes ' Hong', ' HK'. The - pole is flagged dense.
